# README editing instructions

When editing README.md in this repository:

- **preserve the minimalist premium style** — no badge walls, no emoji spam, no carnival aesthetics
- **avoid public stat cards** (github-readme-stats, trophy widgets) unless explicitly requested
- **keep sections concise** — short, intentional copy; no long paragraphs
- **prefer local assets** — use `./assets/` SVGs over third-party rendered badges
- **keep copy sharp and non-generic** — avoid "passionate developer", "tech enthusiast", or corporate buzzwords
- **do not break relative asset paths** — `./assets/hero.svg`, `./assets/divider.svg`, `./github-metrics.svg`, etc.
- **maintain the palette** — background #323437, surface #2c2e31, text #d1d0c5, muted #646669, accent #e2b714
- **use collapsible sections** for secondary content (`<details>` / `<summary>`)
- **preserve whitespace** — breathing room between sections matters
- **lowercase section labels** where it fits the style
